title: Source Facts
subtitle: Non-Recipe Acquisition Cards
summary: Source facts explain where items come from when the answer is a cache, route, mission, trader, structure, research record, or machine process instead of a normal recipe.
body: EchoIndex loads source facts from data/<namespace>/echo_index/source_facts/ and from addon IIndexSourceProvider implementations. It also scans loot tables and worldgen definitions to create safe fallback source cards.
